_comment_en: Orchestrator for the modular, cascading policy engine (see mova.local/sanitize's ResolvePolicyRequest + LoadPolicySetFor). "policies" accepts a bare array or an {include,exclude} object; bare names are resolved by RECURSIVE search under config/policy/, and relative or cross-platform absolute paths are also accepted. This file is the LOWEST-precedence layer: a project.json that declares its own "policies" overrides it completely, and --policies_include/--policies_exclude override both. See docs/i18n/{es,en}/PROJECT_JSON.md.
_comment_es: Orquestador del motor de politicas modular en cascada (ver ResolvePolicyRequest + LoadPolicySetFor en mova.local/sanitize). "policies" acepta un arreglo simple o un objeto {include,exclude}; los nombres simples se resuelven por busqueda RECURSIVA bajo config/policy/, y tambien se aceptan rutas relativas o absolutas multiplataforma. Este archivo es la capa de MENOR precedencia: un project.json que declare su propio "policies" lo sobrescribe por completo, y --policies_include/--policies_exclude sobrescriben a ambos. Ver docs/i18n/{es,en}/PROJECT_JSON.md.
